title: Research tasks are scheduled before the work that needs them
goal: A task with research: true carries the asks it must make known; its done runs pack for each and requires coverage good; an item's asks are marked required or useful, and an item with a required ask that is not sufficient is not ready until a research task covering it is done; backlog.py can create one research task for an item's required asks and add it to the item's depends_on; /kb-research is the skill that works it.

gates.question: Schedule research before the work that needs it, given the measurement in kb/_self/reports/backlog-briefs.md?
gates.recommendation: build only if the with-brief arm used fewer tokens and no more rework in every run
gates.answer: build if the with-brief arm used fewer tokens and had no more refused dones than the arm without it in every run; otherwise drop: asks stay informational; kb/_self/reports/backlog-briefs.md states which held

notes: With 'Verdict: drop' in the report this item's check cannot pass: drop it (backlog.py drop). Dropped: verdict drop in kb/_self/reports/backlog-briefs.md, by its measured gate: asks stay informational
